arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 -c "
import os
tot=0; cnt=0
for r,d,fs in os.walk('.'):
    for f in fs:
        p=os.path.join(r,f); s=os.path.getsize(p); tot+=s; cnt+=1
        print(f'{s:8d} {p}')
print('files',cnt,'bytes',tot)
print('symlinks:', [p for r,d,fs in os.walk('.') for p in [os.path.join(r,f) for f in fs+d] if os.path.islink(p)])
"
